platforms.name: Mobile
platforms.detailedDescription: A B2B mobile application for pet product distributors, engineered as a white-label SaaS product. The core technical achievement was developing a rendering engine where tab bar menus, login requirements, logos, and color schemes are remotely driven by the backend API (Server-Driven UI). This architecture allowed a single app binary to serve multiple franchisees. The application also features advanced catalog navigation, multi-step checkout flows, recurring purchase lists, and camera integration for quick QR Code ordering.
learnings: Architecting a highly scalable and customizable mobile solution using dynamic theme and route injection based on API payloads.
Building complex multi-step forms (wizards) with asynchronous regional validations.
Advanced handling of navigation logic coupled with side effects for programmatic screen redirects during async success or error flows.
